CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION truss.catalog_global_high_water_v01()
 RETURNS TABLE(allocation_domain text, maximum_id text)
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog', 'pg_temp'
AS $function$
BEGIN
  RETURN QUERY
  SELECT 'type_id'::text, GREATEST(COALESCE(MAX(t.type_id)::bigint, 0), 0)::text
  FROM truss.type_def AS t
  UNION ALL
  SELECT 'prop_id'::text, GREATEST(COALESCE(MAX(p.prop_id)::bigint, 0), 0)::text
  FROM truss.prop_def AS p
  UNION ALL
  SELECT 'rel_type_id'::text, GREATEST(COALESCE(MAX(r.rel_type_id)::bigint, 0), 0)::text
  FROM truss.rel_def AS r;
END
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION truss.catalog_key_high_water_v01(original_type_id integer)
 RETURNS TABLE(owner_type_id text, maximum_key_num text)
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog', 'pg_temp'
AS $function$
DECLARE
  retained_type_id int;
BEGIN
  IF original_type_id IS NULL THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'missing original key owner' USING ERRCODE = '22023';
  END IF;
  SELECT t.type_id INTO STRICT retained_type_id
  FROM truss.type_def AS t WHERE t.type_id = original_type_id;
  RETURN QUERY
  SELECT retained_type_id::text,
         GREATEST(COALESCE(MAX(k.key_num)::bigint, 0), 0)::text
  FROM truss.key_def AS k WHERE k.type_id = retained_type_id;
END
$function$

routines.name: edge_limit_verify_current_scope
routines.definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION truss.edge_limit_verify_current_scope()
 RETURNS void
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog', 'pg_temp'
 SET row_security TO 'off'
AS $function$
DECLARE actual_xid xid8:=pg_current_xact_id_if_assigned();
        operation truss.row_home_operation%ROWTYPE;
        relationships bigint; definition_rows bigint; edge_rows bigint; marker_rows bigint;
BEGIN
 -- Explicit test-only caller custody. Production capture/issuer is still absent.
 IF NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM pg_roles WHERE rolname=session_user AND rolsuper)
    OR session_user<>current_user OR actual_xid IS NULL THEN
  RAISE EXCEPTION 'original native test custody required' USING ERRCODE='55000';
 END IF;
 IF NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM pg_locks WHERE pid=pg_backend_pid() AND granted
       AND relation='truss.schema_head'::regclass
       AND mode IN ('ExclusiveLock','AccessExclusiveLock')) THEN
  RAISE EXCEPTION 'original exclusive catalog head required' USING ERRCODE='55000';
 END IF;
 -- No LIMIT/latest-ordinal choice; STRICT refuses zero or multiple candidates.
 SELECT o.* INTO STRICT operation FROM truss.row_home_operation o
  WHERE o.original_writer_xid=actual_xid AND o.phase<>'application_finalized';
 IF operation.operation_kind<>'catalog-acceptance'
    OR operation.phase NOT IN ('admitted','effects_ready','row_sealed') THEN
  RAISE EXCEPTION 'original catalog operation required' USING ERRCODE='55000';
 END IF;
 -- Static whole-catalog source profile: ordinary physical tables, no partitions,
 -- inheritance, views, foreign sources or RLS-filtered observations.
 IF EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM unnest(ARRAY['truss.rel_def'::regclass,'truss.edge'::regclass,
              'truss.edge_limit'::regclass]) AS r(oid)
     JOIN pg_class c ON c.oid=r.oid
     WHERE c.relkind<>'r' OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM pg_inherits i
            WHERE i.inhrelid=c.oid OR i.inhparent=c.oid)) THEN
  RAISE EXCEPTION 'unsupported original relationship source' USING ERRCODE='0A000';
 END IF;
 -- Exact selected native input columns: no text/numeric coercion, NULL-filtered
 -- scope or char-width trimming may silently change the observed meaning.
 IF EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM (VALUES
   ('truss.rel_def'::regclass,'rel_type_id','int4'::regtype,true,-1),
   ('truss.rel_def'::regclass,'source_min','int4'::regtype,true,-1),
   ('truss.rel_def'::regclass,'source_max','int4'::regtype,false,-1),
   ('truss.rel_def'::regclass,'target_min','int4'::regtype,true,-1),
   ('truss.rel_def'::regclass,'target_max','int4'::regtype,false,-1),
   ('truss.edge'::regclass,'id','int8'::regtype,true,-1),
   ('truss.edge'::regclass,'rel_type_id','int4'::regtype,true,-1),
   ('truss.edge'::regclass,'source_id','int8'::regtype,true,-1),
   ('truss.edge'::regclass,'target_id','int8'::regtype,true,-1),
   ('truss.edge_limit'::regclass,'rel_type_id','int8'::regtype,true,-1),
   ('truss.edge_limit'::regclass,'side','bpchar'::regtype,true,5),
   ('truss.edge_limit'::regclass,'endpoint_id','int8'::regtype,true,-1),
   ('truss.edge_limit'::regclass,'edge_id','int8'::regtype,true,-1)
  ) AS expected(relation,name,type,not_null,typmod)
  LEFT JOIN pg_attribute a ON a.attrelid=expected.relation AND a.attname=expected.name
   AND a.attnum>0 AND NOT a.attisdropped
  WHERE a.attnum IS NULL OR a.atttypid<>expected.type OR a.attnotnull<>expected.not_null
    OR a.atttypmod<>expected.typmod) THEN
  RAISE EXCEPTION 'unsupported original relationship columns' USING ERRCODE='0A000';
 END IF;
 -- Counts include every physical row. These logical cardinality bounds do not
 -- claim bounded executor heap, whole-operation work or production admission.
 SELECT count(*) INTO definition_rows FROM truss.rel_def;
 SELECT count(*) INTO edge_rows FROM truss.edge;
 SELECT count(*) INTO marker_rows FROM truss.edge_limit;
 SELECT count(*) INTO relationships FROM (
  SELECT rel_type_id::bigint FROM truss.rel_def
  UNION SELECT rel_type_id::bigint FROM truss.edge
  UNION SELECT rel_type_id::bigint FROM truss.edge_limit) AS universe;
 IF relationships>256 OR definition_rows>256 OR edge_rows>16384 OR marker_rows>32768 THEN
  RAISE EXCEPTION 'relationship correspondence capacity exceeded' USING ERRCODE='54000';
 END IF;
 IF EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM truss.rel_def GROUP BY rel_type_id HAVING count(*)<>1)
    OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM truss.edge GROUP BY id HAVING count(*)<>1) THEN
  RAISE EXCEPTION 'unsupported original relationship identity' USING ERRCODE='0A000';
 END IF;
 -- Whole universe includes orphan/wrong-relationship markers and canonical edges.
 IF EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM (
   SELECT rel_type_id::bigint AS id FROM truss.edge
   UNION SELECT rel_type_id::bigint FROM truss.edge_limit) AS referenced
   WHERE NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM truss.rel_def d WHERE d.rel_type_id=referenced.id)) THEN
  RAISE EXCEPTION 'original relationship definition unavailable' USING ERRCODE='55000';
 END IF;
 IF EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM truss.rel_def d WHERE d.source_min<0 OR d.target_min<0
    OR (d.source_max IS NOT NULL AND d.source_max<d.source_min)
    OR (d.target_max IS NOT NULL AND d.target_max<d.target_min)) THEN
  RAISE EXCEPTION 'unsupported relationship bounds' USING ERRCODE='0A000';
 END IF;
 -- Required marker key conflicts are detected independently of actual markers.
 IF EXISTS(WITH required AS (
   SELECT e.rel_type_id::bigint AS rel,'s'::text COLLATE pg_catalog."C" AS side,e.source_id AS endpoint,e.id
     FROM truss.edge e JOIN truss.rel_def d USING(rel_type_id) WHERE d.target_max=1
   UNION ALL
   SELECT e.rel_type_id::bigint,'t'::text COLLATE pg_catalog."C",e.target_id,e.id
     FROM truss.edge e JOIN truss.rel_def d USING(rel_type_id) WHERE d.source_max=1)
   SELECT 1 FROM required GROUP BY rel,side,endpoint HAVING count(*)>1) THEN
  RAISE EXCEPTION 'required marker key conflict' USING ERRCODE='23505';
 END IF;
 -- EXCEPT ALL preserves multiplicity; both directions must be empty.
 IF EXISTS(WITH required AS (
   SELECT e.rel_type_id::bigint AS rel,'s'::text COLLATE pg_catalog."C" AS side,e.source_id AS endpoint,e.id
     FROM truss.edge e JOIN truss.rel_def d USING(rel_type_id) WHERE d.target_max=1
   UNION ALL
   SELECT e.rel_type_id::bigint,'t'::text COLLATE pg_catalog."C",e.target_id,e.id
     FROM truss.edge e JOIN truss.rel_def d USING(rel_type_id) WHERE d.source_max=1),
   actual AS (SELECT m.rel_type_id::bigint AS rel,m.side::text COLLATE pg_catalog."C" AS side,m.endpoint_id AS endpoint,m.edge_id AS id
     FROM truss.edge_limit m),
   missing AS (SELECT * FROM required EXCEPT ALL SELECT * FROM actual),
   extra AS (SELECT * FROM actual EXCEPT ALL SELECT * FROM required)
   SELECT 1 FROM missing UNION ALL SELECT 1 FROM extra) THEN
  RAISE EXCEPTION 'relationship marker mismatch' USING ERRCODE='55000';
 END IF;
 -- Deliberately no mutation/seal/result token, including the all-three-empty case.
END;
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION truss.runtime_capture_catalog_metadata_cut(expected_writer text, expected_ordinal text, expected_generation text)
 RETURNS bytea
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog', 'pg_temp'
 SET bytea_output TO 'hex'
 SET "TimeZone" TO 'UTC'
AS $function$
DECLARE context jsonb; name text; result jsonb; original bytea;
BEGIN
 PERFORM truss.runtime_require_operation_configuration_current(expected_writer,expected_ordinal,expected_generation);
 SELECT convert_from(o.original_context_bytes,'UTF8')::jsonb INTO STRICT context
 FROM truss.row_home_operation o WHERE o.original_writer_xid=pg_current_xact_id_if_assigned()
  AND o.operation_ordinal::text=expected_ordinal AND o.phase='admitted';
 FOREACH name IN ARRAY ARRAY['installation_marker','source_epoch_current','source_epoch_registry',
   'installation_admission','operation_configuration','installation_archive'] LOOP
  EXECUTE format('LOCK TABLE truss.%I IN SHARE MODE NOWAIT',name);
  IF NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM pg_class c JOIN pg_namespace n ON n.oid=c.relnamespace
    WHERE n.nspname='truss' AND c.relname=name AND c.relkind='r' AND NOT c.relrowsecurity)
   OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM pg_inherits i WHERE i.inhparent=to_regclass(format('truss.%I',name))
    OR i.inhrelid=to_regclass(format('truss.%I',name))) THEN
   RAISE EXCEPTION 'complete ordinary metadata topology required' USING ERRCODE='0A000';
  END IF;
 END LOOP;
 IF (SELECT count(*) FROM truss.installation_marker)<>1
  OR NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM truss.installation_marker m
   WHERE m.singleton_id=1 AND m.installation_id=context->>'installationId'
    AND m.marker_interface_version='truss-bootstrap-marker/0.1.0' AND m.schema_name='truss')
  OR (SELECT count(*) FROM truss.source_epoch_current)<>1
  OR (SELECT count(*) FROM truss.source_epoch_registry)<>1
  OR NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM truss.source_epoch_registry e
   WHERE e.transition_reason='initial' AND e.predecessor_epoch IS NULL)
  OR (SELECT count(*) FROM truss.installation_admission)<>1
  OR (SELECT count(*) FROM truss.operation_configuration)<>1 THEN
  RAISE EXCEPTION 'fresh original metadata identity correspondence required' USING ERRCODE='55000';
 END IF;
 -- Recheck exact unique release membership under the retained archive table lock.
 PERFORM * FROM truss.runtime_select_catalog_report_release(expected_writer,expected_ordinal,
  expected_generation,(SELECT encode(c.admission_profile_bytes,'hex')
   FROM truss.operation_configuration c WHERE c.original_writer_xid=pg_current_xact_id_if_assigned()
    AND c.operation_ordinal::text=expected_ordinal));
 -- Revalidate after acquiring all native locks. This retains exact current rows,
 -- including opaque inventory bytes; no invented inventory interpretation.
 PERFORM truss.runtime_require_operation_configuration_current(expected_writer,expected_ordinal,expected_generation);
 SELECT jsonb_build_object('interfaceVersion','truss-catalog-metadata-cut/0.1',
  'marker',(SELECT to_jsonb(m) FROM truss.installation_marker m),
  'pointer',(SELECT to_jsonb(c) FROM truss.source_epoch_current c),
  'epoch',(SELECT to_jsonb(e) FROM truss.source_epoch_registry e),
  'configuration',(SELECT to_jsonb(c) FROM truss.operation_configuration c),
  'admission',(SELECT to_jsonb(a) FROM truss.installation_admission a),
  'releaseArchive',(SELECT coalesce(jsonb_agg(to_jsonb(a) ORDER BY a.archive_row_id),'[]'::jsonb)
    FROM truss.installation_archive a WHERE a.installation_id=context->>'installationId'
      AND a.artifact_role='input' AND a.artifact_identity='truss.catalog-report-release/0.1.0')) INTO result;
 original:=convert_to(result::text,'UTF8');
 IF octet_length(original)>32768 THEN
  RAISE EXCEPTION 'private original metadata response capacity' USING ERRCODE='54000';
 END IF;
 RETURN original;
END;
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION truss.runtime_collect_catalog_custody_declarations_candidate()
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog', 'pg_temp'
 SET "TimeZone" TO 'UTC'
 SET "DateStyle" TO 'ISO, YMD'
 SET "IntervalStyle" TO 'iso_8601'
 SET extra_float_digits TO '3'
 SET bytea_output TO 'hex'
 SET standard_conforming_strings TO 'on'
 SET quote_all_identifiers TO 'off'
AS $function$
DECLARE result jsonb; routine record; declaration text; members jsonb:='[]'; total bigint:=0;
BEGIN
 IF current_user IS DISTINCT FROM session_user OR NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM pg_roles WHERE rolname=current_user AND rolsuper) THEN
  RAISE EXCEPTION 'administrative original declarations only' USING ERRCODE='42501'; END IF;
 IF (SELECT count(*) FROM pg_proc p JOIN pg_namespace n ON n.oid=p.pronamespace WHERE n.nspname='truss')>1024
  OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM pg_proc p JOIN pg_namespace n ON n.oid=p.pronamespace WHERE n.nspname='truss'
   AND (p.prokind NOT IN ('f','p') OR octet_length(p.prosrc)>1048576 OR octet_length(coalesce(p.proconfig::text,''))>65536))
  OR (SELECT coalesce(sum(octet_length(p.prosrc)::bigint),0) FROM pg_proc p JOIN pg_namespace n ON n.oid=p.pronamespace WHERE n.nspname='truss')>4194304 THEN
  RAISE EXCEPTION 'bounded complete original routine declarations required' USING ERRCODE='54000'; END IF;
 FOR routine IN SELECT p.* FROM pg_proc p JOIN pg_namespace n ON n.oid=p.pronamespace
  WHERE n.nspname='truss' ORDER BY p.proname COLLATE "C",pg_get_function_identity_arguments(p.oid) COLLATE "C" LOOP
  declaration:=pg_get_functiondef(routine.oid);total:=total+octet_length(declaration)::bigint;
  IF octet_length(declaration)>1048576 OR total>4194304 THEN
   RAISE EXCEPTION 'original native declaration capacity' USING ERRCODE='54000'; END IF;
  members:=members||jsonb_build_array(jsonb_build_object(
   'name',routine.proname,'identityArguments',pg_get_function_identity_arguments(routine.oid),
   'definition',declaration,'owner',pg_get_userbyid(routine.proowner),
   'language',(SELECT lanname FROM pg_language WHERE oid=routine.prolang),
   'kind',routine.prokind,'volatility',routine.provolatile,'securityDefiner',routine.prosecdef,
   'strict',routine.proisstrict,'leakproof',routine.proleakproof,'parallel',routine.proparallel,
   'support',routine.prosupport::regprocedure::text,'configuration',to_jsonb(routine.proconfig),
   'acl',(SELECT coalesce(jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('grantor',pg_get_userbyid(a.grantor),
    'grantee',CASE WHEN a.grantee=0 THEN 'PUBLIC' ELSE pg_get_userbyid(a.grantee) END,
    'privilege',a.privilege_type,'grantable',a.is_grantable) ORDER BY pg_get_userbyid(a.grantor) COLLATE "C",CASE WHEN a.grantee=0 THEN 'PUBLIC' ELSE pg_get_userbyid(a.grantee) END COLLATE "C",a.privilege_type),'[]'::jsonb)
    FROM aclexplode(coalesce(routine.proacl,acldefault('f',routine.proowner))) a)));
  IF octet_length(members::text)>4194304 THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'complete declaration carrier capacity' USING ERRCODE='54000'; END IF;
 END LOOP;
 RETURN members;
END;
$function$

routines.name: runtime_collect_catalog_custody_schema_candidate
routines.definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION truss.runtime_collect_catalog_custody_schema_candidate()
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog', 'pg_temp'
 SET "TimeZone" TO 'UTC'
 SET "DateStyle" TO 'ISO, YMD'
 SET "IntervalStyle" TO 'iso_8601'
 SET extra_float_digits TO '3'
 SET bytea_output TO 'hex'
 SET standard_conforming_strings TO 'on'
 SET quote_all_identifiers TO 'off'
AS $function$
DECLARE relation_oid oid; result jsonb;
BEGIN
 IF current_user IS DISTINCT FROM session_user OR NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM pg_roles WHERE rolname=current_user AND rolsuper) THEN
  RAISE EXCEPTION 'administrative original custody schema only' USING ERRCODE='42501'; END IF;
 relation_oid:=to_regclass('truss.catalog_revision_custody');
 IF relation_oid IS NULL THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'original custody home absent' USING ERRCODE='55000'; END IF;
 LOCK TABLE truss.catalog_revision_custody IN SHARE MODE NOWAIT;
 IF (SELECT count(*) FROM pg_attribute WHERE attrelid=relation_oid)>128
  OR (SELECT count(*) FROM pg_constraint WHERE conrelid=relation_oid)>64
  OR (SELECT count(*) FROM pg_index WHERE indrelid=relation_oid)>32
  OR (SELECT count(*) FROM pg_trigger WHERE tgrelid=relation_oid OR tgconstraint IN
   (SELECT oid FROM pg_constraint WHERE conrelid=relation_oid))>64
  OR (SELECT count(*) FROM pg_rewrite WHERE ev_class=relation_oid)>32
  OR (SELECT count(*) FROM pg_policy WHERE polrelid=relation_oid)>32 THEN
  RAISE EXCEPTION 'bounded complete custody schema required' USING ERRCODE='54000'; END IF;
 SELECT jsonb_build_object(
  'relation',jsonb_build_object('kind',c.relkind,'persistence',c.relpersistence,'owner',pg_get_userbyid(c.relowner),
   'accessMethod',(SELECT amname FROM pg_am WHERE oid=c.relam),'options',to_jsonb(c.reloptions),
   'rowSecurity',c.relrowsecurity,'forceRowSecurity',c.relforcerowsecurity,'replicaIdentity',c.relreplident,
   'acl',(SELECT coalesce(jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('grantor',pg_get_userbyid(a.grantor),
    'grantee',CASE WHEN a.grantee=0 THEN 'PUBLIC' ELSE pg_get_userbyid(a.grantee) END,
    'privilege',a.privilege_type,'grantable',a.is_grantable) ORDER BY pg_get_userbyid(a.grantor) COLLATE "C",
     CASE WHEN a.grantee=0 THEN 'PUBLIC' ELSE pg_get_userbyid(a.grantee) END COLLATE "C",a.privilege_type),'[]'::jsonb)
    FROM aclexplode(coalesce(c.relacl,acldefault('r',c.relowner))) a)),
  'columns',(SELECT jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('number',a.attnum,'name',a.attname,'type',format_type(a.atttypid,a.atttypmod),
   'collation',CASE WHEN a.attcollation=0 THEN NULL ELSE a.attcollation::regcollation::text END,
   'notNull',a.attnotnull,'dropped',a.attisdropped,'identity',a.attidentity,'generated',a.attgenerated,
   'storage',a.attstorage,'compression',a.attcompression,'options',to_jsonb(a.attoptions),
   'acl',(SELECT coalesce(jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('grantor',pg_get_userbyid(acl.grantor),
    'grantee',CASE WHEN acl.grantee=0 THEN 'PUBLIC' ELSE pg_get_userbyid(acl.grantee) END,
    'privilege',acl.privilege_type,'grantable',acl.is_grantable) ORDER BY pg_get_userbyid(acl.grantor) COLLATE "C",
     CASE WHEN acl.grantee=0 THEN 'PUBLIC' ELSE pg_get_userbyid(acl.grantee) END COLLATE "C",acl.privilege_type),'[]'::jsonb)
    FROM aclexplode(CASE WHEN cardinality(a.attacl)>0 THEN a.attacl ELSE NULL::aclitem[] END) acl),
   'hasMissing',a.atthasmissing,'missing',CASE WHEN a.atthasmissing THEN a.attmissingval::text ELSE NULL END,
   'default',(SELECT pg_get_expr(d.adbin,d.adrelid) FROM pg_attrdef d WHERE d.adrelid=a.attrelid AND d.adnum=a.attnum))
   ORDER BY a.attnum) FROM pg_attribute a WHERE a.attrelid=relation_oid AND a.attnum>0),
  'constraints',(SELECT coalesce(jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('name',k.conname,'kind',k.contype,
   'definition',pg_get_constraintdef(k.oid),'validated',k.convalidated,'local',k.conislocal,'inherited',k.coninhcount,
   'parent',CASE WHEN k.conparentid=0 THEN NULL ELSE k.conparentid::text END) ORDER BY k.conname COLLATE "C"),'[]'::jsonb)
   FROM pg_constraint k WHERE k.conrelid=relation_oid),
  'indexes',(SELECT coalesce(jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('definition',pg_get_indexdef(i.indexrelid),
   'index',to_jsonb(i)-ARRAY['indexrelid','indrelid','indcollation','indclass','indexprs','indpred']::text[],
   'expressions',pg_get_expr(i.indexprs,i.indrelid),'predicate',pg_get_expr(i.indpred,i.indrelid),
   'relation',jsonb_build_object('name',ic.relname,'kind',ic.relkind,'owner',pg_get_userbyid(ic.relowner),
    'persistence',ic.relpersistence,'accessMethod',(SELECT amname FROM pg_am WHERE oid=ic.relam),'options',to_jsonb(ic.reloptions),
    'acl',(SELECT coalesce(jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('grantor',pg_get_userbyid(acl.grantor),
     'grantee',CASE WHEN acl.grantee=0 THEN 'PUBLIC' ELSE pg_get_userbyid(acl.grantee) END,
     'privilege',acl.privilege_type,'grantable',acl.is_grantable) ORDER BY pg_get_userbyid(acl.grantor) COLLATE "C",
      CASE WHEN acl.grantee=0 THEN 'PUBLIC' ELSE pg_get_userbyid(acl.grantee) END COLLATE "C",acl.privilege_type),'[]'::jsonb)
     FROM aclexplode(coalesce(ic.relacl,acldefault('r',ic.relowner))) acl)))
   ORDER BY ic.relname COLLATE "C"),'[]'::jsonb) FROM pg_index i JOIN pg_class ic ON ic.oid=i.indexrelid WHERE i.indrelid=relation_oid),
  'rules',(SELECT coalesce(jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('name',r.rulename,'definition',pg_get_ruledef(r.oid),'enabled',r.ev_enabled) ORDER BY r.rulename COLLATE "C"),'[]'::jsonb) FROM pg_rewrite r WHERE r.ev_class=relation_oid),
  'policies',(SELECT coalesce(jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('name',p.polname,'command',p.polcmd,'permissive',p.polpermissive,
   'roles',(SELECT jsonb_agg(CASE WHEN role_oid=0 THEN 'PUBLIC' ELSE pg_get_userbyid(role_oid) END ORDER BY CASE WHEN role_oid=0 THEN 'PUBLIC' ELSE pg_get_userbyid(role_oid) END COLLATE "C") FROM unnest(p.polroles) role_oid),
   'using',pg_get_expr(p.polqual,p.polrelid),'check',pg_get_expr(p.polwithcheck,p.polrelid)) ORDER BY p.polname COLLATE "C"),'[]'::jsonb)
   FROM pg_policy p WHERE p.polrelid=relation_oid),
  'triggers',(SELECT coalesce(jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('home',t.tgrelid::regclass::text,
   'name',CASE WHEN t.tgisinternal THEN NULL ELSE t.tgname END,'internal',t.tgisinternal,
   'constraint',(SELECT k.conname FROM pg_constraint k WHERE k.oid=t.tgconstraint),
   'function',t.tgfoid::regprocedure::text,'type',t.tgtype,'enabled',t.tgenabled,'arguments',encode(t.tgargs,'hex'),
   'argumentCount',t.tgnargs,'qualifier',pg_get_expr(t.tgqual,t.tgrelid),
   'deferrable',t.tgdeferrable,'initiallyDeferred',t.tginitdeferred,'attributes',t.tgattr::text,
   'oldTable',t.tgoldtable,'newTable',t.tgnewtable,'hasParent',t.tgparentid<>0)
   ORDER BY t.tgrelid::regclass::text COLLATE "C",t.tgtype,t.tgfoid::regprocedure::text COLLATE "C",(SELECT k.conname FROM pg_constraint k WHERE k.oid=t.tgconstraint) COLLATE "C",t.tgname COLLATE "C"),'[]'::jsonb)
   FROM pg_trigger t WHERE t.tgrelid=relation_oid OR t.tgconstraint IN(SELECT oid FROM pg_constraint WHERE conrelid=relation_oid)),
  'inheritance',(SELECT count(*) FROM pg_inherits WHERE inhparent=relation_oid OR inhrelid=relation_oid))
 INTO STRICT result FROM pg_class c WHERE c.oid=relation_oid;
 IF octet_length(result::text)>1048576 THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'normalized custody schema capacity' USING ERRCODE='54000'; END IF;
 RETURN result;
END;
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION truss.runtime_collect_catalog_custody_target_descriptor_candidate()
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog', 'pg_temp'
 SET "TimeZone" TO 'UTC'
 SET "DateStyle" TO 'ISO, YMD'
 SET "IntervalStyle" TO 'iso_8601'
 SET extra_float_digits TO '3'
 SET bytea_output TO 'hex'
 SET standard_conforming_strings TO 'on'
 SET quote_all_identifiers TO 'off'
AS $function$
DECLARE relation_oid oid; result jsonb;
BEGIN
 -- The normalized observation establishes bounded topology and native exclusion.
 PERFORM truss.runtime_collect_catalog_custody_schema_candidate();
 relation_oid:='truss.catalog_revision_custody'::regclass;
 SELECT jsonb_build_object('relation',to_jsonb(c),
  'attributes',(SELECT jsonb_agg(to_jsonb(a) ORDER BY a.attnum) FROM pg_attribute a WHERE a.attrelid=relation_oid),
  'defaults',(SELECT coalesce(jsonb_agg(to_jsonb(a) ORDER BY a.adnum),'[]'::jsonb) FROM pg_attrdef a WHERE a.adrelid=relation_oid),
  'constraints',(SELECT jsonb_agg(to_jsonb(a) ORDER BY a.oid) FROM pg_constraint a WHERE a.conrelid=relation_oid),
  'indexes',(SELECT jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('index',to_jsonb(i),'relation',to_jsonb(ic),
   'attributes',(SELECT jsonb_agg(to_jsonb(a) ORDER BY a.attnum) FROM pg_attribute a WHERE a.attrelid=ic.oid),
   'definition',pg_get_indexdef(i.indexrelid)) ORDER BY i.indexrelid) FROM pg_index i JOIN pg_class ic ON ic.oid=i.indexrelid WHERE i.indrelid=relation_oid),
  'rules',(SELECT coalesce(jsonb_agg(to_jsonb(a) ORDER BY a.oid),'[]'::jsonb) FROM pg_rewrite a WHERE a.ev_class=relation_oid),
  'policies',(SELECT coalesce(jsonb_agg(to_jsonb(a) ORDER BY a.oid),'[]'::jsonb) FROM pg_policy a WHERE a.polrelid=relation_oid),
  'triggers',(SELECT jsonb_agg(to_jsonb(a) ORDER BY a.oid) FROM pg_trigger a WHERE a.tgrelid=relation_oid OR a.tgconstraint IN (SELECT oid FROM pg_constraint WHERE conrelid=relation_oid)))
 INTO STRICT result FROM pg_class c WHERE c.oid=relation_oid;

 IF octet_length(result::text)>1048576 THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'original target descriptor capacity' USING ERRCODE='54000'; END IF;
 RETURN result;
END;
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION truss.runtime_fence_selected_archive_writes()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog', 'pg_temp'
AS $function$
BEGIN
 IF TG_RELID<>'truss.installation_archive'::regclass OR TG_NARGS<>0
  OR TG_WHEN<>'BEFORE' OR TG_LEVEL<>'STATEMENT'
  OR TG_OP NOT IN ('INSERT','UPDATE','DELETE','TRUNCATE') THEN
  RAISE EXCEPTION 'original archive write fence event required' USING ERRCODE='55000';
 END IF;
 IF EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM pg_catalog.pg_locks l
  WHERE l.locktype='relation' AND l.database=(SELECT oid FROM pg_catalog.pg_database
   WHERE datname=pg_catalog.current_database())
   AND l.relation=TG_RELID AND l.pid=pg_catalog.pg_backend_pid()
   AND l.mode='ShareLock' AND l.granted) THEN
  RAISE EXCEPTION 'selected archive cut excludes same-backend writes' USING ERRCODE='55000';
 END IF;
 RETURN NULL;
END;
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION truss.runtime_require_catalog_lifecycle_observers()
 RETURNS void
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog', 'pg_temp'
AS $function$
BEGIN
 IF NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM pg_proc p WHERE p.oid=to_regprocedure('truss.runtime_observe_catalog_generation()')
  AND NOT p.prosecdef AND p.provolatile='v' AND NOT p.proisstrict AND NOT p.proleakproof
  AND p.prorettype='pg_catalog.trigger'::regtype AND p.prolang=(SELECT l.oid FROM pg_language l WHERE l.lanname='plpgsql')
  AND p.proparallel='u' AND p.proconfig=ARRAY['search_path=pg_catalog, pg_temp']
  AND encode(sha256(convert_to(p.prosrc,'UTF8')),'hex')='50e70fa7cb99454c0104e5e9d14858ba0e8b664cecd3680281173fcdb3d1ca59')
  OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM (VALUES ('schema_rev'),('schema_doc'),('type_def'),('prop_def'),('key_def'),('key_lifecycle_history'),('rel_def'),('rel_endpoint'),('relationship_lineage'),('schema_head'),('catalog_acceptance_report')) v(name)
   WHERE NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM pg_trigger t WHERE t.tgrelid=to_regclass('truss.'||v.name)
    AND t.tgname='runtime_catalog_generation' AND t.tgfoid=to_regprocedure('truss.runtime_observe_catalog_generation()')
    AND t.tgtype=29 AND t.tgenabled='A' AND t.tgnargs=0 AND t.tgqual IS NULL AND NOT t.tgisinternal
    AND t.tgattr=''::int2vector AND t.tgconstraint=0 AND t.tgconstrrelid=0
    AND t.tgconstrindid=0 AND NOT t.tgdeferrable AND NOT t.tginitdeferred
    AND t.tgoldtable IS NULL AND t.tgnewtable IS NULL AND t.tgparentid=0)) THEN
  RAISE EXCEPTION 'exact selected generation observer required' USING ERRCODE='55000';
 END IF;
END;
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION truss.runtime_require_catalog_prerequisite_composition_candidate(w text, o text, g text)
 RETURNS void
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog', 'pg_temp'
 SET "TimeZone" TO 'UTC'
 SET "DateStyle" TO 'ISO, YMD'
 SET "IntervalStyle" TO 'iso_8601'
 SET extra_float_digits TO '3'
 SET bytea_output TO 'hex'
 SET standard_conforming_strings TO 'on'
 SET quote_all_identifiers TO 'off'
AS $function$
DECLARE configuration truss.operation_configuration%ROWTYPE; inventory jsonb; context jsonb;
 raw_manifest bytea; manifest jsonb; resource jsonb; artifact bytea; resource_length bigint;
 total_resource_bytes bigint:=0; expected_paths text[]; selected_paths text[];
 relation_oid oid; target_descriptor jsonb; expected_collector jsonb; actual_collector text;
 actual_routines jsonb; actual_schema jsonb; routine_json jsonb; declaration_bytes bigint:=0;
BEGIN
 PERFORM truss.runtime_require_catalog_observation(w,o,g);
 PERFORM truss.runtime_require_operation_configuration_current(w,o,g);
 LOCK TABLE truss.installation_archive IN SHARE MODE NOWAIT;
 PERFORM truss.runtime_require_selected_archive_write_fence();
 SELECT c.* INTO STRICT configuration FROM truss.operation_configuration c
  WHERE c.original_writer_xid=pg_current_xact_id_if_assigned() AND c.operation_ordinal::text=o;
 SELECT convert_from(t.original_context_bytes,'UTF8')::jsonb INTO STRICT context FROM truss.row_home_operation t
  WHERE t.original_writer_xid=configuration.original_writer_xid AND t.operation_ordinal=configuration.operation_ordinal;
 IF octet_length(configuration.installed_inventory_bytes)>8192 THEN
  RAISE EXCEPTION 'bounded original custody inventory required' USING ERRCODE='54000'; END IF;
 IF NOT(convert_from(configuration.installed_inventory_bytes,'UTF8') IS JSON OBJECT WITH UNIQUE KEYS) THEN
  RAISE EXCEPTION 'original unique custody inventory required' USING ERRCODE='55000'; END IF;
 inventory:=convert_from(configuration.installed_inventory_bytes,'UTF8')::jsonb;
 IF (SELECT count(*) FROM jsonb_object_keys(inventory))<>4
  OR NOT inventory ?& ARRAY['interfaceVersion','scope','referenceManifest','custodyDescriptorSha256']
  OR inventory->>'interfaceVersion' IS DISTINCT FROM 'truss-catalog-custody-installation-inventory/0.4-prerequisite-candidate'
  OR inventory->>'scope' IS DISTINCT FROM 'administrative_rollback_only_catalog_custody'
  OR jsonb_typeof(inventory->'referenceManifest') IS DISTINCT FROM 'object'
  OR (SELECT count(*) FROM jsonb_object_keys(inventory->'referenceManifest'))<>2
  OR NOT inventory->'referenceManifest' ?& ARRAY['identity','sha256']
  OR inventory->'referenceManifest'->>'identity' IS DISTINCT FROM 'truss.catalog-custody-prerequisite-independent-reference/0.1-candidate'
  OR jsonb_typeof(inventory->'referenceManifest'->'sha256') IS DISTINCT FROM 'string'
  OR inventory->'referenceManifest'->>'sha256' !~ '^[0-9a-f]{64}$'
  OR jsonb_typeof(inventory->'custodyDescriptorSha256') IS DISTINCT FROM 'string'
  OR inventory->>'custodyDescriptorSha256' !~ '^[0-9a-f]{64}$'
  OR current_setting('server_version_num') IS DISTINCT FROM '170011' THEN
  RAISE EXCEPTION 'closed original PostgreSQL17 custody inventory required' USING ERRCODE='55000'; END IF;
 IF (SELECT count(*) FROM truss.installation_archive a WHERE a.installation_id=context->>'installationId'
  AND a.artifact_role='input' AND a.artifact_identity=inventory->'referenceManifest'->>'identity')<>1 THEN
  RAISE EXCEPTION 'unique original independent reference required' USING ERRCODE='55000'; END IF;
 SELECT octet_length(a.artifact_bytes)::bigint INTO STRICT resource_length FROM truss.installation_archive a
  WHERE a.installation_id=context->>'installationId' AND a.artifact_role='input'
   AND a.artifact_identity=inventory->'referenceManifest'->>'identity';
 IF resource_length NOT BETWEEN 1 AND 4194304 THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'reference manifest capacity' USING ERRCODE='54000'; END IF;
 total_resource_bytes:=resource_length;
 SELECT a.artifact_bytes INTO STRICT raw_manifest FROM truss.installation_archive a
  WHERE a.installation_id=context->>'installationId' AND a.artifact_role='input'
   AND a.artifact_identity=inventory->'referenceManifest'->>'identity'
   AND a.artifact_identity_sha256=sha256(convert_to(a.artifact_identity,'UTF8'))
   AND a.artifact_sha256=sha256(a.artifact_bytes)
   AND a.artifact_sha256=decode(inventory->'referenceManifest'->>'sha256','hex') FOR SHARE NOWAIT;
 IF NOT(convert_from(raw_manifest,'UTF8') IS JSON OBJECT WITH UNIQUE KEYS) THEN
  RAISE EXCEPTION 'original unique independent reference required' USING ERRCODE='55000'; END IF;
 manifest:=convert_from(raw_manifest,'UTF8')::jsonb;
 IF (SELECT count(*) FROM jsonb_object_keys(manifest))<>7
  OR NOT manifest ?& ARRAY['interfaceVersion','scope','nativeVersion','sourceFiles','resources','routines','custodySchema']
  OR manifest->>'interfaceVersion' IS DISTINCT FROM 'truss-catalog-custody-prerequisite-independent-reference/0.1-candidate'
  OR manifest->>'scope' IS DISTINCT FROM 'administrative_rollback_only_catalog_custody'
  OR manifest->>'nativeVersion' IS DISTINCT FROM '170011'
  OR jsonb_typeof(manifest->'sourceFiles') IS DISTINCT FROM 'array'
  OR jsonb_array_length(manifest->'sourceFiles') NOT BETWEEN 1 AND 128
  OR jsonb_typeof(manifest->'resources') IS DISTINCT FROM 'array'
  OR jsonb_array_length(manifest->'resources')<>71
  OR jsonb_typeof(manifest->'routines') IS DISTINCT FROM 'array'
  OR jsonb_array_length(manifest->'routines') NOT BETWEEN 1 AND 1024
  OR jsonb_typeof(manifest->'custodySchema') IS DISTINCT FROM 'object' THEN
  RAISE EXCEPTION 'complete independently compiled reference required' USING ERRCODE='55000'; END IF;
 -- Original compiler source receipt is metadata, not a target-produced proof.
 FOR resource IN SELECT * FROM jsonb_array_elements(manifest->'sourceFiles') LOOP
  IF jsonb_typeof(resource) IS DISTINCT FROM 'object' OR (SELECT count(*) FROM jsonb_object_keys(resource))<>2
   OR NOT resource ?& ARRAY['path','sha256'] OR jsonb_typeof(resource->'path') IS DISTINCT FROM 'string'
   OR octet_length(resource->>'path') NOT BETWEEN 1 AND 4096 OR jsonb_typeof(resource->'sha256') IS DISTINCT FROM 'string'
   OR resource->>'sha256' !~ '^[0-9a-f]{64}$' THEN
   RAISE EXCEPTION 'closed original compiler source pin required' USING ERRCODE='55000'; END IF;
 END LOOP;
 IF EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM jsonb_array_elements(manifest->'sourceFiles') s GROUP BY s->>'path' HAVING count(*)<>1) THEN
  RAISE EXCEPTION 'unique original compiler sources required' USING ERRCODE='55000'; END IF;
 -- Fixed adjunct path closure is generated from the owner composition roster.
 expected_paths:=ARRAY[
 'docs/helix/02-design/contracts/catalog-revision-custody-storage-v0.1.proposal.umf.json',
 'docs/helix/02-design/models/truss-layout-core-structural-0.9.proposal.umf.json',
 'docs/helix/04-build/evidence/catalog-revision-custody-storage.owner-export.sql',
 'packages/postgresql/native/catalog-custody/configured-graph.sql','packages/postgresql/native/catalog-custody/configured-graph.umf.json',
 'packages/postgresql/native/catalog-custody/fresh-lifecycle.sql','packages/postgresql/native/catalog-custody/fresh-lifecycle.umf.json',
 'packages/postgresql/native/catalog-custody/stage-issued.sql','packages/postgresql/native/catalog-custody/stage-issued.umf.json',
 'packages/postgresql/native/catalog-custody/configured-stage.sql','packages/postgresql/native/catalog-custody/configured-stage.umf.json',
 'packages/postgresql/native/catalog-custody/report-write.sql','packages/postgresql/native/catalog-custody/report-write.umf.json',
 'packages/postgresql/native/catalog-custody/branch-manifest.json',
 'packages/python/src/truss/_profiles/catalog-report-custody-composition-candidate.json',
 'packages/python/src/truss/_profiles/catalog-revision-custody-candidate.json',
 'packages/python/src/truss/_profiles/catalog-revision-wide-report-composition-candidate.json',
 'packages/postgresql/native/catalog-custody/capture.sql','packages/postgresql/native/catalog-custody/capture.umf.json',
 'packages/postgresql/native/catalog-custody/composition-admission.sql','packages/postgresql/native/catalog-custody/composition-admission.umf.json',
 'packages/postgresql/native/catalog-completion/configured-state-candidate.sql','packages/postgresql/native/catalog-completion/configured-state-candidate.umf.json',

 JOIN pg_catalog.pg_namespace n ON n.oid=c.relnamespace
 WHERE n.nspname='truss' AND c.relname='installation_archive' AND c.relkind='r';
 IF (SELECT count(*) FROM pg_catalog.pg_proc p JOIN pg_catalog.pg_namespace n ON n.oid=p.pronamespace
  WHERE n.nspname='truss' AND p.proname='runtime_fence_selected_archive_writes')<>1

    WHERE n.nspname='truss' AND p.proname='runtime_fence_selected_archive_writes'
      AND octet_length(p.prosrc)=694) THEN
  RAISE EXCEPTION 'original installed archive write fence required' USING ERRCODE='55000';
 END IF;

 JOIN pg_catalog.pg_namespace n ON n.oid=p.pronamespace

  OR routine.proallargtypes IS NOT NULL OR routine.proargmodes IS NOT NULL
  OR routine.proargnames IS NOT NULL OR routine.pronargdefaults<>0
  OR routine.proconfig IS DISTINCT FROM ARRAY['search_path=pg_catalog, pg_temp']::text[]
  OR sha256(convert_to(routine.prosrc,'UTF8'))<>decode('9880d745800a1eb0e61f341053c04fdad219172815e95bbad20da369f50eefc9','hex')
  OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM pg_catalog.aclexplode(coalesce(routine.proacl,
    pg_catalog.acldefault('f',routine.proowner))) a
    WHERE a.privilege_type='EXECUTE' AND a.grantee<>routine.proowner)
  OR (SELECT count(*) FROM pg_catalog.pg_trigger t WHERE t.tgrelid=archive_oid AND NOT t.tgisinternal)<>1
  OR NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM pg_catalog.pg_trigger t WHERE t.tgrelid=archive_oid
    AND NOT t.tgisinternal AND t.tgname='runtime_selected_archive_write_fence'
    AND t.tgfoid=routine_oid AND t.tgtype=62 AND t.tgenabled='A'
    AND t.tgnargs=0 AND t.tgargs=decode('','hex') AND t.tgattr=''::int2vector
    AND t.tgqual IS NULL AND t.tgoldtable IS NULL AND t.tgnewtable IS NULL
    AND NOT t.tgdeferrable AND NOT t.tginitdeferred AND t.tgconstraint=0) THEN
  RAISE EXCEPTION 'original installed archive write fence required' USING ERRCODE='55000';
 END IF;
END;
